title: Review Form 1120-S Schedule K classification — Kestrel Designs
instructions: Kestrel Designs, Inc. is an S corporation with two shareholders. The preparer drafted the 2025 Schedule K from the trial balance. Review each line, then resolve the diagnostics. Tick every amount that is wrong and enter the correct amount.

exhibits.title: Trial balance data (2025)
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Gross receipts | 900,000 |
| Cost of goods sold | 400,000 |
| Officer compensation | 150,000 |
| Other salaries and wages | 120,000 |
| Rent | 36,000 |
| Depreciation (MACRS) | 40,000 |
| Health insurance for 2% shareholders (included in their W-2 wages) | 14,000 |
| Section 179 expense | 25,000 |
| Charitable contributions | 8,000 |
| Interest income (savings account) | 3,000 |
| Qualified dividends | 2,000 |
| Long-term capital gain (stock) | 5,000 |
| Section 1231 gain (equipment) | 12,000 |
| Life insurance premiums on officers (corporation is beneficiary) | 4,000 |
| Penalty for late filing of payroll forms | 1,500 |
| Distributions to shareholders | 80,000 |

parts.prompt: Review the prepared Schedule K amounts.

rows.label: Ordinary business income (Schedule K line 1)
rows.explanation: 900,000 − 400,000 − 150,000 − 120,000 − 36,000 − 40,000 − 14,000 = **140,000**. The §179 deduction and charitable contributions are separately stated, and interest income is portfolio income, so none of them enter ordinary income.

rows.label: Section 179 deduction (line 11)
rows.explanation: Separately stated because each shareholder's §179 limit applies: **25,000**.

rows.label: Charitable contributions (line 12a)
rows.explanation: Separately stated; shareholders deduct them subject to their own limits: **8,000**.

rows.label: Nondeductible expenses (line 16c)
rows.explanation: Officer life insurance 4,000 + penalty 1,500 = **5,500**. They reduce shareholder basis but not taxable income.

parts.prompt: Choose the correct resolution for each diagnostic.

rows.label: Health insurance for 2% shareholders (14,000) is deducted as an employee benefit.
options: Clear the flag — it is included in the shareholders' W-2 wages
Separately state it on Schedule K
rows.answer: Clear the flag — it is included in the shareholders' W-2 wages
rows.explanation: An S corporation deducts 2% shareholders' health premiums when they are reported as wages; the shareholders may then take the self-employed health insurance deduction.

rows.label: Charitable contributions were deducted in computing ordinary business income.
options: Separately state them on Schedule K
rows.answer: Separately state them on Schedule K

rows.label: The penalty expense account has no Schedule K entry.
options: Report it as a nondeductible expense on line 16c
rows.answer: Report it as a nondeductible expense on line 16c
rows.explanation: Nondeductible expenses reduce basis and AAA but are never deducted.
